Configure current feature

  1. Assign DA_Dialogue_Mara and DA_Quest_RoadSupplies; author village chain FirstSteps -> RoadSupplies -> TheSluiceSignal. Add journal/tracker/dialogue/choice UI and server event receipts.
  2. RoadSupplies fixture requires1kill,1loot,2ore,3logs,1fish,1craft. Reward100XP+200currency through one final claim transaction; use recorded server events, not client counters.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Create/select A, speak to Mara, accept available quest and leave village. Fight/loot, mine/chop/fish, craft, buy/sell and equip a visible or labeled-compatible item.
  2. Open journal after each approved event; re-open dialogue to observe changed conditions. Reach a level threshold and verify native progression recomputation.
  3. Return to Mara and claim once; resend final claim while disconnecting/crossing zones. Die/recover and re-login.
Expected success
Slice B route completes with correct persistent inventory/XP/currency/profession/quest facts; event replay does not overcount and final claim grants once.
NPC actor/dialogue screen never owns the character’s quest/inventory truth; close modal safely during death/travel.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Daily/repeatable policy remains disabled until approved. Escort quests and schedules need AI/recovery proof before production.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Slice B includes quest/fight/loot/gather/fish/craft/shop/equip/death/reconnect.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
